nodes.label: AS-SEC-001-GOV-007 — Control-Character Mid-Keyword Evasion Remediation
nodes.rationale: Owner selected bounded deterministic normalization (Option 1) over whitelist-style normalization, scoped only to closing U+0009/U+000A/U+000D mid-keyword evasion; neither always-convert-to-space nor always-remove alone satisfies both the mid-keyword-reunification and between-words-boundary requirements, so consecutive-run length is used as the deterministic signal (runs of two-or-more collapse to one space as a paragraph break, isolated single occurrences are tested both as space and as removed, and findings from both variants are unioned) since local per-character context cannot disambiguate the two cases.

nodes.label: GOV-006 residual Zs/Zl/Zp mid-keyword gap (unaddressed)
nodes.rationale: Fresh fuzzing found GOV-006's own Zs/Zl/Zp-to-space remediation has the same unaddressed mid-keyword gap GOV-007 just closed for tab/LF/CR (e.g. an em-space inserted mid-word still bypasses); explicitly out of GOV-007's owner-authorized scope and captured as a visible strict xfail test rather than silently dropped, so GOV-006 cannot be marked closed.
